title: List the cold snapshot's task tree under the listing limit so audits of more than about 11,000 tasks are not refused
outcome: List the cold snapshot's task tree under the listing limit so audits of more than about 11,000 tasks are not refused
acceptance: The cold task snapshot (read_task_snapshot) lists .engram/tasks under the listing byte limit (MAX_LISTING_BYTES) rather than the general 1 MiB query output limit, so a snapshot of 20,000 tasks is not refused with DestinationTreeLimit at the listing step
A behaviour test reads a cold snapshot whose task-tree listing exceeds 1 MiB and gets every document
